name: dense_induction
statement: M → Prop} (x : M) {s : Set M} (hs : closure L s = ⊤) (Hs : ∀ x ∈ s, p x) (Hfun : ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : L.Functions n), ClosedUnder f (setOf p)) : p x

have_tree.type: ∀ x ∈ closure L s, p x
have_tree.body: fun x hx => closure_induction hx Hs fun {n} => Hfun

name: substructureReduct
statement: L →ᴸ L') [φ.IsExpansionOn M] : L'.Substructure M ↪o L.Substructure M where toFun S
